If you're booking on behalf of others, please ensure you share the waiver link with them so they can complete it in advance. Please give us a call at 360-424-7630 with any questions or concerns.
cancellation: All reservations are charged in full at the time of booking. We accept cancellations up to 48 hours before your scheduled ride time. Weather cancellations are at the sole discretion of Lang's Horse & Pony Farm. We will ride as long as it will be safe and enjoyable.
